name: mcp-issue-loop
description: Label-driven loops that take an issue from rough idea to merged PR: `ai-discuss` talks it into shape before anyone builds it, `ready-for-ai` builds it to a CI-green PR, `auto-rework` acts on your review feedback. Bundles issue-discuss-loop, issue-build-loop, rework-loop, and mcp-review. Runs locally (worktrees + parallel subagents + local tests) or as a cloud routine. Repo-agnostic.
